Actress Rashmika Mandanna Injured During Dance Shoot, Advised Rest

Actress Rashmika Mandanna sustained a major hip injury, specifically a hip tendon detachment, while filming an intense dance sequence. Doctors have recommended a six-week period of complete rest for her recovery. This injury is expected to affect her current film schedules and endorsement deals.
